description: Na₃VSO₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent S and four equivalent O atoms. There is one shorter (2.93 Å) and one longer (3.11 Å) Na-S bond length. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.75 Å. V is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one S and three equivalent O atoms. The V-S bond length is 2.25 Å. All V-O bond lengths are 1.73 Å. S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six equivalent Na and one V atom. O is bonded to four equivalent Na and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄V trigonal bipyramids.
